_about: The rifle set. barrelIn is the barrel length the loads' speeds are given for. sightHeightIn is how far the sight line sits above the bore for each sight the rifle can carry. boreOffsetMoa is the rifle's mechanical offset with the sight at its middle setting: the reason a sight needs zeroing. sights lists the sights (data/sights.json) the rifle can carry.

barrelIn.estimate: the brief gives the barrel as 16 or 18 inches, unsure; 16 is used and marked. BCM's 16-inch carbines: https://www.bravocompanymfg.com/bcm-recce16-mcmr.html

source.note: "A standard AR sight plane is 2.6 inches above the bore, the height of an M4's front sight base"; BCM publishes no figure. read from the search engine's indexed text of this page on the date given: this session's network allowed web search but no page fetches

up.estimate: a sight set to its mechanical middle is a few minutes off on most rifles; the figure is chosen so the rifle needs zeroing, not measured

right.estimate: same basis as the elevation offset

recoilFactor.estimate: the reference for the view's recoil: a 5.56 carbine

source.note: IWI US: 16.5 in barrel, 26.125 in overall, 7.9 lb (the brief said 16 in; IWI's figure is used). read from the search engine's indexed text of this page on the date given: this session's network allowed web search but no page fetches

tavor-irons.estimate: IWI publishes no sight height. Owners report 3.75 in on a SAR (https://ar15.com/forums/armory/X95_scope_mount_height/43-476622/) and about 2.1 in for a dot on a SAR (Reddit); Manticore's replacement rail is sold as raising the factory rail about half an inch to AR height (https://www.opticsplanet.com/manticore-arms-tavor-x95-overwatch-top-rail.html). 3.0 is the middle of the reported band; the field report gives the second crossing for the whole band

barrelIn.estimate: the importer (FIME Group, https://fimegroup.com/vepr-rifle/vepr-762x54r/) lists the thumbhole-stock Vepr in 7.62x54R with 16.5 in (VPR-76254-01), 20.5 in (VPR-76254-02) and 23.2 in (VPR-76254-03) barrels; the brief describes a long barrel of about 18 in, so the 20.5-inch model is the nearest listed length and is used. If the rifle was the 23.2-inch model the loads' speeds rise by about 55 fps

vepr-irons.estimate: not published by Molot or FIME; AK-pattern irons sit 1.9 in over the bore (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AK-47), and one review of the .308 Vepr says about 4 in, which does not fit an AK receiver; 2.0 used

utg-2-7x44.estimate: a scope on the Vepr's side rail mount sits about an inch above the irons; no maker figure

up.estimate: a freshly mounted scope on a side rail is usually several minutes off; chosen so the rifle needs zeroing, not measured

right.estimate: same basis: the same basis as the figure next to it in this entry

recoilFactor.estimate: a 7.62x54R rifle kicks far harder than a 5.56 carbine; the brief asks for a longer recoil on this rifle
